no_tenant_explained: Your account exists, but no tenant has you as a member, so there is no data for you to see. Ask an instance admin or a tenant’s owner to add you.
tenant_switch_failed: Could not switch to that tenant. You may no longer be a member of it.
tenant_changed: The tenant changed since this page was opened. Nothing was done; reload the page and try again.
admin_tenants_intro: Each tenant's data and API keys are kept apart from every other tenant's. Only an instance admin creates tenants, and a tenant cannot be deleted yet.
admin_tenant_slug_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. acme-prod.
admin_tenant_name_invalid: Give the tenant a name of at most 100 characters.
admin_tenant_slug_invalid: A slug is lowercase letters and digits, joined by single hyphens, at most 63 characters.
admin_tenant_slug_taken: Another tenant already has this slug.
admin_tenant_owner_missing: Choose an existing user as the owner.
admin_member_add_hint: An existing account. New accounts are made on the Users page.
admin_member_invalid: Choose a user and a role.
admin_member_exists: That user is already a member of this tenant.
admin_member_no_user: That user or tenant no longer exists. Reload the page.
admin_member_not_found: That member is no longer in this tenant. Reload the page.
admin_member_last_owner: A tenant keeps at least one owner. Make another member an owner first.
admin_member_no_candidates: Every user is already a member of this tenant.
admin_member_remove_explained: They lose access to this tenant's data at their next request. Their account stays.
admin_users_intro: The accounts of this panel. Sign-up is closed, so an account is made here or with scripts/create-user.ts.
admin_user_instance_admin_hint: Creates tenants and accounts and manages the members of every tenant.
admin_user_created: {email} was created. Add the account to a tenant on that tenant's page; until then it sees only a page saying it belongs to no tenant.
admin_user_email_invalid: That is not an e-mail address.
admin_user_exists: An account with this e-mail already exists.
admin_user_password_length: The password must be {min} to {max} characters long.
api_keys_intro: An agent sends its key in the DD-API-KEY header with every request. The intake refuses data that comes without a valid one. Data sent with a key goes to the tenant the key was made in.
api_key_created_explained: Copy it now: it will not be shown again. Only its hash is stored.
api_key_not_active_yet: The panel could not notify the intake, so the key starts working within 30 seconds, at the intake's next refresh.
api_key_new_hint: Name it after the machines that will use it.
api_key_name_invalid: Give the key a name of at most 100 characters.
api_key_id_invalid: The form did not name a valid key. Reload the page and try again.
api_key_not_found: That key is no longer in this tenant. Reload the page.
api_keys_empty: This tenant has no keys yet
api_keys_empty_hint: Create one to connect an agent.
api_key_delete_explained: The intake stops accepting this key, usually at once and within 30 seconds at most. This cannot be undone.
api_key_not_revoked_yet: The key is deleted, but the panel could not notify the intake, so it may accept the key for up to 30 more seconds.
